changes.title: Magic letters
items: Your 💌s leave a faint warm trail as they fly, land on the ground with a soft rose puff, and a hit lands with a rose ring and amber sparks instead of a white flash

changes.title: Creator amber
items: The character creator wears the game's lantern amber (its Start button, sliders and chosen options), to match the in-game HUD
On a slow machine, the forest no longer stalls loading while the creator is open

changes.title: Party warm 2
items: Each party area's string lights are warm white with a few bulbs in that area's own colour, and home's decorations and lights are all its cyan, instead of every colour at once
